# Roadmap

## Goals

Make CSV obfuscation and restoration safer to use for library and CLI users, while maintaining synthetic CSV generation as an equally important product capability. Harden the current 0.1 line over the next 1–2 releases, prioritizing safe data handling and risk reduction.

## Non-goals

Do not claim obfuscation alone provides cryptographic secrecy. Do not require encrypted manifests by default. Do not target a 1.0 release in this roadmap.
